intro.title: Your files and conversations are waiting.
paragraphs: Sign in to return to your last active project or the task you paused. Each document's thread keeps its discussion and draft; project topics keep their attached documents.

aside.title: Trouble signing in?
paragraphs: Forgot your password? [Contact support](/ai-chat/help). If sign-in fails, check your details and try again.
